---
  title: 'Power analysis for: Is metal folding just a series of rotations?'
---
  
  ```{r libraries, message=FALSE}
library(designr) # functions for the design matrix and to perform simulations
library(tidyverse) # data handling functions and plotting
library(lme4) # mixed models
library(lmerTest) # df estimations for mixed models
library(patchwork) # arranging plots
```

```{r settings, results = "hide", message=FALSE, warnings = FALSE}
## SIMULATION SETTINGS ##
nsubj <- seq(20,50,5)
nsim <- 100 # how many times to simulate each sample size
powerThreshold <- 0.8 # between 0-1
alphaThreshold <- 0.05 # between 0-1

## ERP MODEL PARAMETERS ##
ERP_fix     <- c(-0.4,-0.2,0.8,1.0) # based on prior study
ERP_fix     <- ERP_fix*.75 # reduce down by 25% to account for possible smaller effect size
ERP_sd_Subj <- 2.0 
ERP_sd_Res  <- 1.0  
ERP_SESOI   <- -0.3 # smallest effect size of interest for minimum effects testing

## RT MODEL PARAMETERS ##
RT_fix      <- c(4000, 3600, 3400, 3000) # based on prior study
RT_fix      <- RT_fix*.75 # reduce down by 25% to account for possible smaller effect size
RT_sd_Subj  <- 280
RT_sd_Res   <- 170
RT_SESOI    <- 100 # smallest effect size of interest for minimum effects testing

## plot the predicted ERP effect ##
dfERP <- data.frame(
  ERP_fix = ERP_fix,
  Rotation = factor(c(90, 90, 40, 40)),  
  Folding = factor(c(6, 4, 6, 4))        
)

# create the bar plot
pERP = ggplot(dfERP, aes(x = Rotation, y = ERP_fix, fill = Folding)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("lightgray", "darkgray"),
    labels = c("4" = "4 faces carried", "6" = "6 faces carried")
  )+
  labs(x = "Rotation Condition (°)", y = "Microvolts (µV)", fill = "Folding Condition") +
  ylim(-0.5, 1) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.position = c(0.95, 0.95),
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),       # smaller color boxes
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),    # smaller legend labels
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6)    # smaller legend title
  )
# ggsave("ERP_barplot.png", plot = p, width = 4, height = 6, dpi = 300)

## plot the predicted RT effect ##
dfRT <- data.frame(
  ERP_fix = RT_fix,
  Rotation = factor(c(90, 90, 40, 40)),  
  Folding = factor(c(6, 4, 6, 4))        
)

pRT = ggplot(dfRT, aes(x = Rotation, y = RT_fix, fill = Folding)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("lightgray", "darkgray"),
    labels = c("4" = "4 faces carried", "6" = "6 faces carried")
  )+
  labs(x = "Rotation Condition (°)", y = "RT (ms)", fill = "Folding Condition") +
  # ylim(-0.5, 1) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.position = c(0.90, 0.25),
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),       # smaller color boxes
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),    # smaller legend labels
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6)    # smaller legend title
  )
```

print(pERP)
```

```

This is the code used to simulate the data and perform the analysis. For reproducibility purposes, it is not run in this output because we load in the exact simulated results used in the pre-registration.

```{r run simulations, results = "hide", warnings = FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# data frames to store model results
ERP_COF <- data.frame()
RT_COF <- data.frame()

# loop through all sample sizes
for (i in 1:length(nsubj)) {
  
  # set up the design to be simulated
  ERPdesign <-
    fixed.factor("rotation", levels=c("rotationHigh90", "rotationLow40")) +
    fixed.factor("folding", levels=c("foldingHigh6", "foldingLow4")) +
    random.factor("Subj", instances=nsubj[i])
  RTdesign <-
    fixed.factor("rotation", levels=c("rotationHigh90", "rotationLow40")) +
    fixed.factor("folding", levels=c("foldingHigh6", "foldingLow4")) +
    random.factor("Subj", instances=nsubj[i]) +
    random.factor("Stimuli", instances=10) +
    random.factor("Block", instances=5)
  
  ERPdat <- design.codes(ERPdesign)
  RTdat <- design.codes(RTdesign)
  nsj <- length(unique(ERPdat$Subj))
  
  # set contrasts 
  contrasts(ERPdat$rotation) <- c(1, 0)
  contrasts(ERPdat$folding)  <- c(1, 0)
  contrasts(RTdat$rotation) <- c(1, 0)
  contrasts(RTdat$folding)  <- c(1, 0)
  
  # compute factor F
  ERPdat$F <- factor(paste0(ERPdat$rotation, ".", ERPdat$folding))
  RTdat$F <- factor(paste0(RTdat$rotation, ".", RTdat$folding))
  
  # simulate this sample size the defined number of times, and run an LMM each time, and store the result
  for (j in 1:nsim) {  
    
    # ERP simulate data
    ERPdat$ysim <- simLMM(form = ~ -1 + F + (1| Subj), data=ERPdat,
                          Fixef=ERP_fix, VC_sd=list(ERP_sd_Subj, ERP_sd_Res))
    
    # ERP run model and store result
    ERP_LMM <- lmer(ysim ~ rotation * folding + (1| Subj), data=ERPdat)
    ERP_LMMcof <- coef(summary(ERP_LMM))[1:4,5]
    ERP_LMMlowerCI_95 <- confint(ERP_LMM)[4:6,1]
    ERP_LMMupperCI_95 <- confint(ERP_LMM)[4:6,2]
    ERP_LMMlowerCI_90 <- confint(ERP_LMM, level = .9)[4:6,1]
    ERP_LMMupperCI_90 <- confint(ERP_LMM, level = .9)[4:6,2]
    ERP_COF <- rbind(ERP_COF,c(nsj, j, ERP_LMMcof,ERP_LMMlowerCI_95, ERP_LMMupperCI_95, 
                               ERP_LMMlowerCI_90, ERP_LMMupperCI_90, isSingular(ERP_LMM)))
    
    # RT simulate data
    RTdat$ysim <- simLMM(form = ~ -1 + F + (1| Subj), data=RTdat,
                         Fixef=RT_fix, VC_sd=list(RT_sd_Subj, RT_sd_Res))
    
    # RT run model and store result
    RT_LMM <- lmer(ysim ~ rotation * folding + (1| Subj), data=RTdat)
    RT_LMMcof <- coef(summary(RT_LMM))[1:4,5]
    RT_LMMlowerCI_95 <- confint(RT_LMM)[4:6,1]
    RT_LMMupperCI_95 <- confint(RT_LMM)[4:6,2]
    RT_LMMlowerCI_90 <- confint(RT_LMM, level = .9)[4:6,1]
    RT_LMMupperCI_90 <- confint(RT_LMM, level = .9)[4:6,2]
    RT_COF <- rbind(RT_COF,c(nsj, j, RT_LMMcof, RT_LMMlowerCI_95, RT_LMMupperCI_95, 
                             RT_LMMlowerCI_90, RT_LMMupperCI_90, isSingular(RT_LMM)))
    
  }
}

```


```{r organise, results = "hide", message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# results from LMMs - calculate significance
names(ERP_COF) <- c("num_subj","sim_num", 
                    "pval_intercept","pval_rotation1","pval_folding1","pval_rotation1:folding1", 
                    "lCI_95_rotation1","lCI_95_folding1","lCI_95_rotation1:folding1", 
                    "uCI_95_rotation1","uCI_95_folding1","uCI_95_rotation1:folding1", 
                    "lCI_90_rotation1","lCI_90_folding1","lCI_90_rotation1:folding1", 
                    "uCI_90_rotation1","uCI_90_folding1","uCI_90_rotation1:folding1", 
                    "singular")
ERP_COF$psign_NHST <- as.numeric(ERP_COF$pval_rotation1 < alphaThreshold) # main effect of rotation angle on ERP for power analysis
ERP_COF$minimum_effect_testing <- as.numeric((ERP_COF$lCI_95_rotation1 < ERP_SESOI) & (ERP_COF$uCI_95_rotation1 < ERP_SESOI))
ERP_COF$equivalence <- as.numeric((ERP_COF$lCI_90_rotation1 > ERP_SESOI) & (ERP_COF$uCI_90_rotation1 < -ERP_SESOI))
ERP_COF$model <- 'ERP'

names(RT_COF) <- c("num_subj", "sim_num", 
                   "pval_intercept","pval_rotation1","pval_folding1","pval_rotation1:folding1",
                   "lCI_95_rotation1","lCI_95_folding1","lCI_95_rotation1:folding1", 
                   "uCI_95_rotation1","uCI_95_folding1","uCI_95_rotation1:folding1", 
                   "lCI_90_rotation1","lCI_90_folding1","lCI_90_rotation1:folding1", 
                   "uCI_90_rotation1","uCI_90_folding1","uCI_90_rotation1:folding1", 
                   "singular")
RT_COF$psign_NHST  <- as.numeric(RT_COF$pval_rotation1 < alphaThreshold) # main effect of rotation angle for on RT power analysis
RT_COF$minimum_effect_testing <- as.numeric((RT_COF$lCI_95_rotation1 > RT_SESOI) & (RT_COF$uCI_95_rotation1 > RT_SESOI))
RT_COF$equivalence <- as.numeric((RT_COF$lCI_90_rotation1 > -RT_SESOI) & (RT_COF$uCI_90_rotation1 < RT_SESOI))
RT_COF$model <- 'RT'

# put together ERP and RT models in one data frame
sim_results_combined <- rbind(ERP_COF, RT_COF)
# write.csv(sim_results_combined, "./COF_eff_size.csv")

```

Here we load in the simulated results used in the power analysis that was obtained from the above code
```{r}
sim_results_combined = read.csv("./COF_eff_size.csv")
```

```{r visualise results}

sim_results_combined_long <- sim_results_combined %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(psign_NHST, minimum_effect_testing),  
    names_to = "test_type",  
    values_to = "value" 
  )

sim_summary = sim_results_combined_long %>%
  group_by(num_subj,model, test_type) %>%
  summarise(power = mean(value))

sim_summary$test_type

test_type_labels <- c(
  "minimum_effect_testing" = "Minimum Effect Testing",
  "psign_NHST" = "NHST Significance"
)


# make plot
power_curve_plot = ggplot(data = sim_summary, aes(x = num_subj, y = power * 100)) +
  geom_point(stat = "summary",fun = mean, size = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(stat = "summary",fun = mean, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(stat = "summary", fun = mean,) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(floor(min(sim_results_combined$num_subj)), 
                                  ceiling(max(sim_results_combined$num_subj)), 
                                  by = 10)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = powerThreshold*100, linetype = "dotted", color = "blue", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "Sample size", y = "Power (%)") +
  facet_grid(model ~ test_type, labeller = labeller(test_type = test_type_labels))+
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=-Inf)) + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=-Inf)) + 
  coord_cartesian(clip="off")+
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6))

# ggsave(plot = power_curve_plot, filename = "power_curve_plot.jpg", height = 10, width = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 600)
print(power_curve_plot)


# put with other plot
combined_plot <- pERP + power_curve_plot +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2)) +        # Left plot is 1x width, right is 2x
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a')      # Auto-labels as (a), (b)

# Show the combined plot
combined_plot

# ggsave(plot = combined_plot, filename = "combined_plot.tiff", height = 10, width = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 600)



```

```{r calculate minimum sample sizes to reach the desired power level, results = 'hide'}
# NHST
ERPpowerIndex = min(which(sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "ERP" & sim_summary$test_type == "psign_NHST",]$power > powerThreshold))

if(is.infinite(ERPpowerIndex)){
  ERPpower = max(sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "ERP"& sim_summary$test_type == "psign_NHST",]$power)
  ERPpowerIndex = min(which(sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "ERP"& sim_summary$test_type == "psign_NHST",]$power == ERPpower))
  ERPsubs = sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "ERP"& sim_summary$test_type == "psign_NHST",]$num_subj[ERPpowerIndex]
}else{
  ERPpower = sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "ERP" & sim_summary$test_type == "psign_NHST",]$power[ERPpowerIndex]
  ERPsubs = sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "ERP" & sim_summary$test_type == "psign_NHST",]$num_subj[ERPpowerIndex]
}

RTpowerIndex = min(which(sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "RT" & sim_summary$test_type == "psign_NHST",]$power > powerThreshold))

if(is.infinite(RTpowerIndex)){
  RTpower = max(sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "RT" & sim_summary$test_type == "psign_NHST",]$power)
  RTpowerIndex = min(which(sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "RT" & sim_summary$test_type == "psign_NHST",]$power == RTpower))
  RTsubs = sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "RT" & sim_summary$test_type == "psign_NHST",]$num_subj[RTpowerIndex]
}else{
  RTpower = sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "RT" & sim_summary$test_type == "psign_NHST",]$power[RTpowerIndex]
  RTsubs = sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "RT" & sim_summary$test_type == "psign_NHST",]$num_subj[RTpowerIndex]
}

# minimum effect
ERPminimumEffectIndex = min(which(sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "ERP" & sim_summary$test_type == "minimum_effect_testing",]$power > powerThreshold))

if(is.infinite(ERPminimumEffectIndex)){
  ERPminimumEffect = max(sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "ERP"& sim_summary$test_type == "minimum_effect_testing",]$power)
  ERPminimumEffectIndex = min(which(sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "ERP"& sim_summary$test_type == "minimum_effect_testing",]$power == ERPminimumEffect))
  ERPminimumEffectsubs = sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "ERP"& sim_summary$test_type == "minimum_effect_testing",]$num_subj[ERPminimumEffectIndex]
}else{
  ERPminimumEffect = sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "ERP" & sim_summary$test_type == "minimum_effect_testing",]$power[ERPminimumEffectIndex]
  ERPminimumEffectsubs = sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "ERP" & sim_summary$test_type == "minimum_effect_testing",]$num_subj[ERPminimumEffectIndex]
}

RTminimumEffectIndex = min(which(sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "RT" & sim_summary$test_type == "minimum_effect_testing",]$power > powerThreshold))

if(is.infinite(RTminimumEffectIndex)){
  RTminimumEffect = max(sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "RT" & sim_summary$test_type == "minimum_effect_testing",]$power)
  RTminimumEffectIndex = min(which(sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "RT" & sim_summary$test_type == "minimum_effect_testing",]$power == RTminimumEffect))
  RTminimumEffectsubs = sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "RT" & sim_summary$test_type == "minimum_effect_testing",]$num_subj[RTminimumEffectIndex]
}else{
  RTminimumEffect = sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "RT" & sim_summary$test_type == "minimum_effect_testing",]$power[RTminimumEffectIndex]
  RTminimumEffectsubs = sim_summary[sim_summary$model == "RT" & sim_summary$test_type == "minimum_effect_testing",]$num_subj[RTminimumEffectIndex]
}

```
